artworks.title: Venice
artworks.artist: James McNeill Whistler
artworks.medium: etching with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 x 29.5 cm (7 7/8 x 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius L. and Anita Zelman Fund
artworks.description: This image captures a scene looking across a body of water towards a city skyline. The horizon is low in the composition, aligning with the distant line where the city meets the sky. Various buildings and structures, including a prominent domed architecture, dot the horizon. The artwork features delicate, sketchy lines, giving an impression of lightness and fluidity. The color palette is minimal, showcasing natural tones of pencil or charcoal on off-white paper with subtle variations in shading creating depth and texture. Closest to us are several wooden poles in the water, while in the distance, small boats float near the city landscape.

artworks.title: Funeral Monument to the Daughters of Feuerabend
artworks.artist: German 16th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on two joined sheets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical crucifixion scene. Jesus is depicted on the cross with two other figures, set against a detailed landscape with onlookers and soldiers. Surrounding the central scene are oval panels of figures in religious attire, bordered by scrollwork, cherubs, and Latin text. At the bottom, there are additional decorative motifs and supporting figures.

artworks.title: Allegory of Poverty Hindering Wit
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a contrapposto pose, with his weight on the right leg and left leg slightly bent. His left arm is extended upwards with a bird perched on the back of his hand, and his right arm holds a strap wrapped around a large rock. The man has a bushy beard, curly hair, a neutral expression, and is looking up at his raised hand. He is wearing draped clothing over one shoulder and tied around his waist, revealing a muscular torso. There is a small tree stump and grass around his feet, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Erna Lying on the Beach among Rocks
artworks.artist: Ernst Ludwig Kirchner
artworks.medium: reed pen and black ink
artworks.description: The image is a minimalistic line drawing of a nude figure lying on their side. The figure is stretched out horizontally with their head turned towards the viewer. The hair is depicted with simple lines. There are no clothes, jewelry, or objects in the drawing. The background shows semi-circular shapes resembling an abstract landscape against a blank backdrop.

artworks.title: Bouquet d'arbres au ruisseau (Stand of Trees on a River)
artworks.artist: Henri-Joseph Harpignies
artworks.medium: etching on oatmeal paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with trees and foliage. The horizon is low in the background. Trees with detailed branches and leaves dominate the scene. The artwork features fine etching with precise strokes that vary in density, adding depth. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown. A stream or path winds through the scene, flanked by shrubbery and undergrowth. The landscape continues with more vegetation in the distance.

artworks.title: Title-Border with Putti Holding the Pirckheimer Arms
artworks.artist: Albrecht Dürer
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative border featuring cherubs, columns, and floral motifs. The image includes a rectangular blank space in the center, bordered by intricate patterns and designs. The top and sides display floral and vegetative forms, including grapes and scrolling vines. On the left, a long-necked bird is depicted among the foliage. On the right, a figure is shown playing a pan flute on top of a classical column. At the bottom, two cherubic figures hold a coat of arms featuring a stylized flower emblem. The artwork is detailed, combining classical and natural elements harmoniously.

artworks.title: Head of an Elderly Woman with Upturned Eyes
artworks.artist: Antonio del Castillo
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.5 x 14.4 cm (7 11/16 x 5 11/16 in.)
support: 21.2 x 15.2 cm (8 3/8 x 6 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a detailed portrait of an individual from the head to the upper shoulders, almost entirely front-facing. The person's head is slightly tilted upwards. The drawing showcases distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes looking upwards, pronounced cheekbones, and slightly parted lips. The shading emphasizes wrinkles and expressions on the face. The individual has long, straight hair that falls over their shoulders and frames their face. They are depicted wearing a garment over their head and shoulders. The drawing is monochromatic, likely created using pencil or charcoal, adding texture to the hair and fabric. The background is plain. The bottom left corner bears the inscription "A. Caselli," while the number "32" is noted in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: The Falconer
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.9 × 7.2 cm (3 1/2 × 2 13/16 in.)
support: 9.4 × 7.8 cm (3 11/16 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a person riding a horse. The person is seated on the horse with their profile visible. They have a feathered hat, and their facial features are partially obscured. The person's hair is tied back and fits under the hat. They are dressed in a garment with gathered sleeves and wear a cape over their shoulders. A large tree is near the rider, and in the background, another figure on horseback is visible. Both riders are shown with detailed linework capturing the horses' form and motion. The scene is set in an open, illustrated landscape with minimal ground details and distant trees.

artworks.title: A Spaniel Jumping
artworks.artist: Jan Verkolje I
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog. The dog is depicted in mid-movement, with a mix of dark and light tones in its coat. The dog's head is lifted upwards, and the background includes tall grass and a tree with a broken trunk. The shading and tone create a warm atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Federico Barocci
artworks.medium: engraving and etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a central reclining figure. The composition features dramatic drapery and emotive expressions. Surrounding the central figure are several individuals engaged in gestures suggesting mourning or contemplation. The scene is set against a backdrop featuring trees, a large cross under construction, and castle-like structures. In the foreground, various objects like a hammer, pliers, a crown of thorns, and nails are depicted. The bottom of the image contains an elaborate coat of arms with Latin inscriptions. The details and shading create a visually complex and expressive narrative scene.

artworks.title: Two Angels Holding a Coat of Arms
artworks.artist: Jost Amman
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over chalk on two joined sheets
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-bodied figures standing in a pose facing each other. Both figures have detailed facial features, voluminous hair, and large wings. They wear elaborate clothing and are barefoot. Between them is a decorative crest or shield with heraldic symbols. They stand on an ornately carved pedestal. The background is a simple surface.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body. The individual is facing slightly to the right of the frame but looking towards the viewer. They have a serene expression with prominent eyes and a gentle smile. The person's hair is covered by a traditional headpiece. The attire is formal, with a dark garment under a white collar. Surrounding the figure is an octagonal frame with inscriptions, and the background has intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a woman seated in a composed position facing forward. Her facial features are finely detailed, with a smooth complexion and an expressionless gaze. She has curly hair that falls to her shoulders and is partially covered by a transparent veil. She is wearing an elegant garment consisting of a lace collar and a richly textured bodice. Around her neck, there is a distinct necklace. The border of the portrait contains text, implying a frame-like design, while the background behind the woman is a shaded texture.

artworks.title: Arnauld d'Andilly
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the mid-torso up. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the right while looking directly at the viewer. The person's facial features include a long face, prominent cheekbones, and a slight, reserved expression. Their hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and parted down the middle. The attire consists of a buttoned-up garment with visible stitching and a large, flat collar. The person is not wearing any jewelry or holding objects. The background consists of an intricately designed frame resembling a stone pattern, with inscriptions around the hexagonal border surrounding the portrait.

artworks.title: Charles de Valois, duc d'Angouleme
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.6 x 23.8 cm (11 5/8 x 9 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait, visible from the torso up within an octagonal frame. The man has a distinct face with wavy hair, a mustache, and is dressed in elaborate clothing typical of 17th-century fashion. The background has a simple patterned design, while the octagonal frame includes text naming the subject.

artworks.title: Saint Charles, Cardinal Borromeo
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper body portrait of a man in profile. He has a strong nose, thin lips, a pointed chin, deep-set eyes, and a focused expression. The man wears a cap fitting snugly on his head, partially covering his hair, with curls visible around his ear. He is dressed in a robe resembling clergy attire, likely made of heavy fabric with button detailing. The background has a lined texture, and the portrait is framed by a decorative octagonal border with inscriptions. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The style is similar to an etching, with detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: Saint Charles, Cardinal Borromeo
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.8 x 24.4 cm (12 1/8 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body in profile from the chest up. The man faces left, showing a side view of his face, including his nose, chin, and expression. He wears a hat and a robe-like garment, suggesting clerical or scholarly attire. The background features a textured circular frame with a thick oval border. The engraving style gives the image a classic and detailed look.

artworks.title: Honorine Grimberge, comtesse de Bossu
artworks.artist: Jean Morin
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in an off-the-shoulder gown with curly dark hair, wearing a pearl necklace and earrings. She is positioned at a slight angle, with a decorative brooch on her dress. The background features an ornate frame with inscriptions including her title and name. The portrait is rendered in a monochromatic, engraved style.

artworks.title: Armand de Bourbon-Conti
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Justus van Verus
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 35.1 x 24.2 cm (13 13/16 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, from the chest up. The individual is positioned slightly turned to the right, with their head facing forward and their gaze directed towards the left. They have wavy hair falling to their shoulders, along with refined features including eyebrows, a long nose, and slightly pursed lips. The person is dressed in formal clothing with a prominent collar, silky fabric, and a long chain with a large cross pendant around their neck. The portrait is framed in an oval frame with decorative elements including an ornamental crest with initials. The artwork is monochromatic with fine lines and shading typical of engraved portraiture.

artworks.title: Theophile Brachet de la Milletiere
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper torso of a man facing the viewer at a slight angle. He has detailed facial features, a long face, wavy hair, and wears a textured garment with an open collar and an ornate pattern. The portrait is enclosed in an ornate octagonal frame with inscriptions along the edges. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the man in the frame.

artworks.title: Anne Sophie Herbert, comtesse de Carnarvon
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29 x 23.3 cm (11 7/16 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a woman's upper body, with her facing forward and slightly turned to the side. She has curly hair, styled in ringlets. The woman has delicate eyes, a straight nose, and a subtle smile. She wears an elegant gown with puffed sleeves and a ruffled neckline, adorned with ornate details. She also wears a single-strand pearl necklace. The background features a textured surface encased in an intricate frame.

artworks.title: Gilbert de Choiseul du Plessis Praslin
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man's upper body facing forward, head slightly turned. His expression is serious, with distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and wavy hair. He is dressed in clerical attire with a high-collared garment and a cross pendant. The engraving is framed, likely showing his title and name. The background is simple, and the portrait is emphasized by its octagonal framing.

artworks.title: Gilbert de Choiseul du Plessis Praslin
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is depicted in a forward-facing position, with his head slightly turned to his left. The man has a solemn expression with pronounced facial features, including a high forehead and a small mouth. His hair is medium-length, curly, and light in color, with a center parting. He is wearing a clerical garment with a prominent, stiff collar and a cross hanging from his neck. The background consists of a decorative frame with an octagonal shape, which contains inscriptions in Latin on its borders. The background behind the figure is lightly hatched.

artworks.title: Francois Potier, marquis de Gevres
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showcasing the upper body of a man depicted in an intricately illustrated style. The man is positioned at an angle, turned slightly to his right, with his gaze facing forward. His facial features include a pointed nose, pursed lips, and a calm expression. His hair is styled in loose, wavy curls just below his ears. He is wearing historical armor with a lace collar underneath. His left hand is either tucked into his clothing or holding a piece of it. The portrait is framed by a detailed border with French inscriptions and a subtle pattern behind the man.
